How to play

Fill a horizontal row to clear it. Reach 15 lines to win.

  • ← / → or A / D: move. Hold to slide.
  • ↑ / X: rotate clockwise. Z: rotate counterclockwise.
  • ↓ / S: soft drop. Hold to fall faster. Space: drop one piece instantly to its outlined position.
  • The next piece is shown beside the board. Each shuffled set contains all seven shapes.
  • You can briefly adjust a landed piece. Falling speed increases every 5 lines.
  • Earn stars at 5, 10, and 15 lines. Each new star gives 10 coins, once.
  • If a new piece cannot fit, the round ends. Your rewards stay saved.

P or Escape pauses or resumes. Switching tabs pauses automatically.
